nodes.title: SG-5.1 · Export source interface and stable JSON export type
nodes.body:
Context: the devion workseed handoff needs frozen contributions in a stable format. backend/internal/contribution has Contribution, FileStore.ListByRound and no export types. Desired behavior: the package exposes an export source interface and a JSON export type carrying round id, contribution ids, authors, content and timestamps, with documentation, importing no removed code (worker, execution). Why: removal of dev automation must not break the handoff.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the contribution package, when compiled, then an exported export source interface and an exported JSON export type exist
- Given an export value, when marshalled to JSON, then it contains round id, and per contribution id, author, content and created-at timestamp
- Given export.go files, when imports are inspected, then none reference worker or execution packages


## Scope
- In scope: New types and interface in backend/internal/contribution
- Out of scope: Exporter implementation
- Out of scope: FileStore.FrozenIDs
- Out of scope: HTTP routes or CLI
- Preserve: Existing Contribution, FileStore and Repository behavior


## Technical constraints
- Go package contribution, module github.com/worldseed/storyforge/backend
- Must not import removed code


## Definition of done
- Types, interface and docs exist and compile
- Unit tests pass


## Non-functional requirements
- JSON field names are stable snake_case


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Stable documented JSON export type with round id, ids, authors, content and timestamps
nodes.body:
Context: no export type exists. Desired behavior: exported Export and ExportContribution structs with explicit json tags and doc comments describing the format and its version. Expected result: marshalling yields a stable shape. Why: the devion handoff consumes it.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given an Export, when json.Marshal runs, then keys include version, world_id, round_id, contributions
- Given an ExportContribution, when marshalled, then keys are id, author, content, created_at with RFC3339 time
- Given the types, when read, then each has a doc comment


## Scope
- In scope: Export, ExportContribution structs, ExportVersion const
- Out of scope: Producing exports
- Preserve: Contribution struct unchanged


## Technical constraints
- Only stdlib and existing contribution package


## Definition of done
- Struct tags and docs present


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Export source interface supplies a round's contributions and imports no removed code
nodes.body:
Context: FileStore.ListByRound(ctx, worldID, roundID) already lists contributions. Desired behavior: a documented ExportSource interface with that method so exporters depend on an abstraction; FileStore satisfies it. Why: allows mocking and handoff independence from removed code.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given FileStore, when assigned to ExportSource, then it compiles
- Given a fake ExportSource, when ListByRound is called, then it returns its contributions
- Given export source files, when imports are parsed, then none contain worker or execution


## Scope
- In scope: ExportSource interface and compile-time assertion
- Out of scope: Exporter logic
- Preserve: FileStore.ListByRound signature


## Technical constraints
- Method signature must equal FileStore.ListByRound


## Definition of done
- Interface documented and asserted


## Clarifying questions
- None
